answer: Picture a jade ledger where each agent may only trade through funded payment channels to five peers the protocol picks at random, and every channel needs its own locked collateral that can't be reused on any other link. An old fable says a sparrow can't nest in five trees at once; neither can one deposit. A forger running 200 clones must lock 1,000 separate deposits and keep serving unrelated peers on each link, so honest agents pay once while sybil fleets pay per fake identity.
